Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Southwestern Transitional Area Rug, 4 x 6 Foot, Multi
Materials: Polypropylene
Brighten your hallway or other narrow space with this gorgeous Southwest-inspired rug. Rich blues, oranges, and reds interact to create a captivating design that’s distinctly Southwestern and a perfect accent for either contemporary- or vintage-style home decor. 2'6" x 8' Polypropylene Frisee Machine made 0.33 Med
